mapper.select: SELECT p.*, d.dept_name as dept_name, CASE p.gender WHEN '0' THEN '男' WHEN '1' THEN '女' ELSE '' END as gender_text, CASE p.status WHEN '0' THEN '在职' WHEN '1' THEN '离职' ELSE '' END as status_text FROM biz_personnel p LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON p.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE p.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
